positive.prompt: Run autoresearch to optimize my test suite
Start an experiment loop to shrink our bundle size
Keep trying optimizations overnight while I sleep and only keep the ones that make the build faster
What's the autoresearch status, how many experiments so far?
Cancel the autoresearch run and give me a summary

negative.prompt: Set up ML autoresearch on my RTX 5090
Optimize val_bpb for my GPT pretraining runs autonomously
Start autonomous LLM training experiments on this GPU overnight

evals.prompt: The project lives in ./slow-project — treat it as the project root and initialize a git repository there. Set up autoresearch to reduce the wall-clock runtime of `bash slow.sh` (primary metric: total seconds, lower is better). Run the setup phase through the baseline measurement and record it, then STOP once the baseline is logged — do not continue into the experiment loop; this is a setup verification run.
evals.expected_output: Session files created (autoresearch.md, autoresearch.sh), an autoresearch/* git branch, the benchmark actually executed once, and autoresearch.jsonl containing a config header plus a baseline entry with a numeric metric.
expectations: A git repository is initialized (or reused) for slow-project and a branch named autoresearch/<something> is created
autoresearch.md and autoresearch.sh are created, and autoresearch.sh emits METRIC name=value lines including the primary runtime metric
The benchmark script is actually executed at least once via a Bash tool call to measure the baseline
autoresearch.jsonl contains a config header line with "type":"config" and "bestDirection":"lower", followed by a baseline entry with a numeric metric value
A running status marker (a line with "type":"status" and "state":"running") is written to autoresearch.jsonl after the config header (F4)
.gitignore is updated to ignore the living session files autoresearch.jsonl and autoresearch.md (and the setup commit, if any, does not include autoresearch.md) — F5 revert-safety
The agent stops after recording the baseline as instructed, instead of continuing the experiment loop

evals.prompt: My project is in ./status-session. What's the autoresearch status?
evals.expected_output: A status summary computed from autoresearch.jsonl: 5 total runs (3 keep, 1 discard, 1 crash), baseline 5230 ms, best 4230 ms, ~19% improvement — with no files modified.
expectations: The agent reads status-session/autoresearch.jsonl (and/or autoresearch.md) via tool calls before answering
The reported totals match the log: 5 runs, 3 kept, 1 discarded, 1 crashed
The reported baseline (5230 ms) and best (4230 ms) metric values match the log
No files are modified and no new experiments are started

evals.prompt: Resume autoresearch in ./maxed-session and keep optimizing the test runtime.
evals.expected_output: The agent recomputes the current-segment run count (3) from autoresearch.jsonl, sees it has reached max_iterations (3) from .claude/autoresearch-ai-plugin.local.md, and stops with a DONE (max_iterations) conclusion WITHOUT running another experiment.
expectations: The agent reads maxed-session/autoresearch.jsonl and the .claude/autoresearch-ai-plugin.local.md config before acting
The agent determines the current-segment run count is 3 and that max_iterations is 3
The agent concludes the session is at its max_iterations limit and stops (a DONE/max_iterations conclusion)
No new experiment is run: no new commit, no benchmark execution, no new run entry appended to autoresearch.jsonl

evals.prompt: Resume autoresearch in ./stuck-session and keep trying to shrink the bundle.
evals.expected_output: The agent recomputes the consecutive discard/crash streak from autoresearch.jsonl (9 trailing failures in the current segment, > 8), recognizes the segment is stuck, and stops with a WALL conclusion instead of grinding out another doomed experiment.
expectations: The agent reads stuck-session/autoresearch.jsonl before acting
The agent identifies that the recent runs are a long run of consecutive discards/crashes (a streak greater than 8) in the current segment
The agent stops with a WALL / stuck-segment conclusion rather than immediately launching another experiment on the same failing approach
If it does anything further, it proposes a fundamentally different direction or a new segment rather than a minor variation of the failing attempts

evals.expected_output: The agent reads autoresearch.jsonl, sees the last {"type":"status"} record is 'cancelled', and does NOT silently resume — it reports the session was cancelled and asks the user whether to restart, rather than launching an experiment.
expectations: The agent reads cancelled-session/autoresearch.jsonl before acting
The agent recognizes the last status marker is 'cancelled' and that the session is concluded
The agent does NOT silently resume: no new experiment is run and no new run entry is appended
The agent surfaces the cancelled state and asks the user whether to restart rather than proceeding on its own
